title: Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: A hearty and flavorful dish inspired by the cuisine of Argentina, featuring tender beef skewers smothered in a smoky marinade.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
3. Add beef cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with marinade.
4. Thread 4-5 beef cubes onto each skewer.
5. Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
6. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until beef reaches 145°F for medium-rare.
7. Let skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
8. Serve with chimichurri sauce for dipping.
